title: Market Metrics That Matter: Derivatives October 2026 Volume Highlights
summary: Cboe Global Markets, a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.
body_markdown:
October was a record month for Cboe’s Global Derivatives business with Cboe's proprietary index options setting a monthly Average Daily Volume (ADV) record of 6.9 million contracts, driven by a record monthly ADV in S&P 500® Index Options (SPX®) and Mini SPX-Index (XSP®) options. Global Trading Hours (GTH) also had a record month with an ADV of 283,600 contracts traded.


## Index Options


- October was a record month for Cboe’s proprietary index options with an ADV of 6.9 million contracts.
- October 16 marked a record day for Cboe’s proprietary index options with 10.44 million contracts traded, and October 30 marked the second-best day with 10.17 million contracts traded.
- S&P 500 Index Options (SPX) had a record monthly ADV of 5.5 million contracts traded and SPX zero-days-to-expiry (0DTE) options had a record ADV of 3.58 million contracts.
- Mini S&P 500 Index Options (XSP) had a record monthly ADV of 303,000 contracts traded.


## Global Trading Hours


- Global Trading Hours (GTH) had a record month with an ADV of 283,600 contracts traded. GTH recently expanded for five ETFs and 24 single stocks on October 19, 2026.
- SPX and XSP had a record month during GTH with an ADV of 232,900 and 35,800 contracts traded, respectively.


## From the Cboe Trading Floor in Chicago


- SPX represented 43.1% of floor ADV.
- SPX open outcry ADV was 727,356 contracts.
- Cboe’s proprietary products represented 70.3% of floor volume.


## News and Insights


- [Cboe Global Markets Reports Trading Volume for October 2026](https://ir.cboe.com/news/news-details/2026/Cboe-Global-Markets-Reports-Trading-Volume-for-October-2026/default.aspx)
- [Cboe Clear U.S. received Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) approval](https://ir.cboe.com/news/news-details/2026/Cboe-Clear-U-S--Receives-SEC-Approval-to-Expand-Clearing-Capabilities/default.aspx) to expand clearing capabilities to clear securities products in addition to futures and swaps products. This temporary registration enables Cboe Clear U.S. to clear binary securities options tied to specified corporate key performance indicators (KPIs).
- [Cboe rolled out](https://www.cboe.com/notices/content/?id=62365) S&P 500 Index (SPX) AM-settled weekly options on November 9, 2026. The trading symbol is SPXO.
